tutor-topic@K-2.text: The sun warms the water. Then the water floats up into the air. Great question!

tutor-topic@3-5.text: Evaporation is when the sun warms water and it rises into the air. It is like a puddle that dries up on a sunny day. Great thinking, thanks for asking!

tutor-topic@6-8.text: Evaporation is the process where heat from the sun turns liquid water into water vapor, a gas. This is how puddles slowly disappear after rain. It is the first step of the water cycle, so nice question!

tutor-topic@9-12.text: Evaporation is the phase change in which liquid water absorbs energy from the sun and becomes water vapor. Because warmer water molecules move faster, more of them escape into the air. This drives the water cycle and feeds cloud formation, so it is a great question to explore.
